pressure_note: total cell pressure ('The cell pressure was measured using a Druck 960 strain gauge pressure transducer'); absolute vs gauge not stated; Pressure of the equilibrated gas / flow tube ('P / MPa +-0.03 MPa'); the paper does not say whether absolute or gauge or total or partial. Water content is evaluated at atmospheric pressure from the measured frost-point temperature.
uncertainty_stated: T +-0.1 K, P +-0.03 MPa, water content +-1 %
title_as_printed: Experimental and predicted water contents, in ppmV, for methane in equilibrium with hydrates at 283.1 K(+-0.1 K) at different P conditions.

footnotes_as_printed.table note: Uncertainty of temperature is +-0.1 K, pressure is +-0.03 MPa and water content is +-1% of the water content in ppmV.

value.what: water content of the gas in ppmV (volume ppm; mole/volume basis not stated, ideal-gas equivalence assumed by the method), measured via frost-point temperature at atmospheric pressure

conversion_needs: ppmV to mole fraction if mole basis (not stated)
notes: T = 283.1 K printed only in the title. Methane in equilibrium with hydrates (regime hydrate per title).
quality_remarks: ppmV is taken as mole ppm (ideal gas at atmospheric pressure); the paper never states mole or volume basis but derives the water content from the frost-point temperature at atmospheric pressure. P is the equilibrium-cell pressure measured with a strain-gauge transducer (absolute vs gauge not stated). Transducer range quoted 0-41 MPa while Table 5 reaches 56.84 MPa.
